title: Fiscal Policy Under Pressure from High Debt and Risks
discussion_signal: The post interprets the IMF Fiscal Monitor as a public warning that high government debt, geopolitical conflict, and fiscal risk constrain policy choices and force difficult prioritization decisions.
linked_research_question: How do debt and geopolitical risks reshape the political feasibility of spending on security, aging, climate, investment, and social protection?
limits: The post summarizes IMF analysis rather than presenting independent fiscal estimates
It does not show country-specific distributional effects
The discussion highlights risk and does not establish which policy choices are politically feasible in practice
